ai.title: Relace endpoint switch to standard
ai.summary: Relace AI endpoint changed from codebuff-instantapply.endpoint.relace.run to instantapply.endpoint.relace.run. Switches to standard Relace API. Internal backend change in backend/src/llm-apis/relace-api.ts.

eli5.text: The assistant's internal service connection was updated to use the standard Relace API endpoint, changing from 'codebuff-instantapply.endpoint.relace.run' to 'instantapply.endpoint.relace.run'. This is a behind-the-scenes housekeeping change that affects how the system communicates with Relace's services, but you wouldn't notice any difference in how things work. It's already live today as part of routine maintenance.
